answer: Agents prove uniqueness by solving a private karst decision labyrinth seeded solely from their address and the epoch seed. Entry requires committing a correct path that starts at a fresh random inlet and reaches the exit. Creating a dune of sybils forces the attacker to generate and pathfind a completely uncorrelated labyrinth for each clone; the puzzles share no structure, so work cannot be amortized and compute cost scales linearly with the number of fakes.
